## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION, not a pure risk-on or risk-off. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmed by VXX falling (VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND) and Stocks vs Bonds strength (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND), while credit stress is rising (Credit Spread 0.7303 1W: +0.18% | 1M: +1.08% ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) — mixed signals consistent with ROTATION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit widening: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.09%) → flat | ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.13%) → flat | ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD shows CREDIT STRESS ↑. Stocks vs bonds supportive: SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-accommodative: SPY/TLT ↑ (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND) while the dollar is soft (UUP (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -1.87%) → flat | BELOW TREND) and the yield curve in RECOVERY (Yield Curve 1W: +0.09% | 1M: -2.23% → flat | RECOVERY).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and growth leading: Materials (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND, Financials (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and Technology via XLK (XLK (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +7.01%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) are showing strength; defensives lag with XLU (XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND) weak. Style: Growth and Cyclicals showing leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leading but EM catching up: SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (EEM (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +3.74%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) and FXI (FXI (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +0.59%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) are positive; China tech is weak (China Tech vs US Tech 1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.46% ↓ falling | BELOW TREND).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk is present: IWM (IWM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +7.35%) → flat | ABOVE TREND) and ARKK (ARKK (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.76%) → flat | ABOVE TREND) showing inflows, while IBIT (IBIT (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +3.50%) → flat | CORRECTION) is mixed — speculation healthy but selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals and industrials strong: PPLT (PPLT (1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND), SLV (SLV (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +43.13%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) and CPER (CPER (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +9.91%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) leading; gold supportive (GLD (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +10.52%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strength but mixed signals: XLE (XLE (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) and BNO (BNO (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +0.91%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) up, while natural gas is in RECOVERY (UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY) — watch 1M weakness in gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Equities leadership and falling VXX (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND; VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND). DIVERGENCE: credit (Credit Spread 1W: +0.18% | 1M: +1.08% ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) and China tech weakness are offsets — minor-to-moderate divergence.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and growth exposures (Materials/XLK/SOXX/SOXX (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit; reduce exposure to defensives and long-duration bonds (XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials/precious metals (PPLT (1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83%) ABOVE TREND) and Semis/SOXX (SOXX (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Utilities/Real Estate (XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND; XLRE (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Precious metals and base metals (GLD (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Natural gas downside over 1M remains a risk despite short-term bounce (UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) RECOVERY).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (current VXX 27.10 — watch for complacency if it drops below 20), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (current Credit Spread/HYG_LQD ~0.73 — monitor credit stress), XLK/XLF pivot ~2.0 (Tech vs Financials current 2.6331 — monitor rotation back to cyclicals).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, confirmed by falling VXX (VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND) and Stocks vs Bonds strength (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) offset by rising credit stress (Credit Spread 1W: +0.18% | 1M: +1.08% ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND). Materials, Financials and Tech showing relative strength (PPLT, SOXX, XLK). Key risk: credit spread uptick and China tech weakness — monitor HYG/LQD and China tech metrics.
